parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (compensated push-pull) and comparators (uncompensated open-collector) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
Confirm total supply span (V+ - V-) stays within recommended limits.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.
Multiply by channel count for total IC standby current draw.
RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.
Higher CMRR rejects common-mode noise; lower voltage noise improves SNR.
Important when driving heavy resistive loads or high supply rails.

swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: MC33202DR2G is limited to 12 V max (13 V abs max, p.3) whereas OPA2134UA supports up to 36 V (36 V abs max, p.5). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS op-amp on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (MC33202DR2G: IN=RR, OUT=RR vs OPA2134UA: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 3.6x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs OPA2134UA: 8 MHz p.7); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 20x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs OPA2134UA: 20 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and OPA2134UA (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to supply voltage Vs,max drops >20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; GBWP differs >= 3x. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 12 V (p.1) vs 36 V (p.5), max Vos is 8 mV (p.3) vs 3.5 mV (p.7), input bias current is 80000 pA (p.3) vs 5 pA (p.7), and Iq/ch is 900 µA (p.4) vs 4000 µA (p.8). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 190 vs 160 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
